headline: Electronic invoicing for small traders in a single receipt
summary: A bill in the Dominican Republic proposes letting colmados and similar small shops group their sales into a single electronic fiscal receipt rather than issuing one per transaction. It responds to difficulties small merchants face adapting to e-invoicing.
why: Electronic invoicing rules set compliance costs for small retailers and shape how tax authorities collect data on informal commerce.
original_headline: Facturación electrónica a pequeños comerciantes en un solo comprobante
